`System.getProperty("otel.semconv-stability.opt-in")` may be null when running the default test task. Passing a null value to `GenericContainer.withEnv()` can throw (and would prevent Kafka Connect from starting). Consider only setting `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN` when the system property is non-null, or default it to an empty string/omitting the env var.

threads.body: On a parsing `RuntimeException`, this now returns `DbInfo.DEFAULT`, losing any info that may have been derived from `props` (and potentially losing the best-effort parsed URL data). Previously the method returned a partially-populated `DbInfo` on error. Consider returning the best-effort `ParseContext` result (or at least preserving system/connection properties) instead of always returning `DEFAULT` in the catch block.

The Javadoc for `parseUrl()` says the database path is a fallback and does not override an existing database name, but the implementation unconditionally assigns `this.databaseName` from the path when present. Either update the comment or change the logic to match the documented precedence to avoid future misuses of this helper. ```suggestion *

If the URL contains a database path, it is applied to this context and overrides any * previously set database name. ```
